VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUIRED @ 2677b3d9496d9d0c6bd7744f0c8131d37b3f1ac6
REVIEWED_HEAD: 2677b3d9496d9d0c6bd7744f0c8131d37b3f1ac6

Read the full 25-file diff, changed code, reader/writer consumers, tests, writer-population scan specs and vendored schemas. Scanned 1,280 production TS files.
Executed read-only source probes with passing contrasts; verified HEAD and clean status. Vitest was unavailable, so I did not independently reproduce the claimed 454 tests.

- **P1 — Registration bypasses range consent.** [scenario-graph-register.ts:1005](/private/tmp/cx-olumi-assistants-service-2382-2677b3d9-90359/src/routes/assist.v1.scenario-graph-register.ts:1005)
  Class: initial registration and replacement; canonical, nested and slash carriers; bounds, meaning, source and quote changes. An owner can persist a valid new/changed range without dedicated approval. Changing native quantity/unit while copying the range also retains stale metadata. Ownership, CAS and replay checks do not establish range consent.
  Fix: compare the final postimage with the stored base, require server-bound approval for range changes, and clear inherited ranges when native quantity/unit changes. Registration negatives are missing.

- **P1 — Generic edits trust the request echo.** [edit-graph.ts:3978](/private/tmp/cx-olumi-assistants-service-2382-2677b3d9-90359/src/orchestrator/tools/edit-graph.ts:3978)
  Class: echo-added, changed, omitted or stale ranges followed by an unrelated edit; graph-management off/shadow, plus live first-write without a stored base. The guard compares against `context.graph`; persistence subsequently replaces stored nodes with the edited echo.
  Probe: echo comparison allowed an injected range; stored-base comparison detected it; the actual merge retained it.
  Fix: enforce range consent and native-quantity preservation against the strict stored base before committing. Echo contrasts are missing.

- **P1 — Approved ranges cannot round-trip through generic replacements.** [encode-option-interventions.ts:513](/private/tmp/cx-olumi-assistants-service-2382-2677b3d9-90359/src/orchestrator/tools/encode-option-interventions.ts:513)
  Class: canonical whole-map replacements through `applyOperations` and `edit_graph`. Including the unchanged approved range is refused by the presence guard; omitting it while repeating the same native quantity silently deletes it. Nested/slash overlays without a range preserve it—the passing contrast.
  Probes reproduced both rejection and loss.
  Fix: distinguish inherited ranges from new consent structurally; carry the stored range for unchanged quantities and drop it for changed quantities. Add actual-port round-trip tests.

- **P1 — Logging failure restores an invalid range.** [persisted-graph-projection.ts:97](/private/tmp/cx-olumi-assistants-service-2382-2677b3d9-90359/src/orchestrator-v5/persisted-graph-projection.ts:97)
  Class: malformed ranges, missing finite points and points outside bounds; nodes/options and promoted legacy carriers across projection callers. If `log.info` throws after sanitation, the catch returns the original graph. The terminal writer does not validate ranges.
  Probe: point 10 with range 12–20 was removed normally and restored when logging threw.
  Fix: isolate best-effort logging and always retain the sanitized result; fail closed on validator failure. Failure-branch tests are missing.

- **P2 — Explicit false changes ordinary non-range admission.** [agent-capabilities.ts:4261](/private/tmp/cx-olumi-assistants-service-2382-2677b3d9-90359/src/orchestrator-v5/agent-lane/runtime/agent-capabilities.ts:4261)
  Class: standalone levels and delegated starting-point levels with `range_user_stated:false` and no range fields. Presence treats this ordinary level as an incomplete range and refuses it.
  Probe: flag omitted passed; false failed. Valid digit/word range readings passed without invoking the wording matcher.
  Fix both predicates to use true or actual range fields; test omitted/false equivalence while retaining malformed-range refusals.

Also checked dedicated approval/read-back, referee, add-option, system events, registration, restore, hash/currentness, wire withholding and legacy reload. New positive tests bind targets by identity; they miss the blocking contrasts above.
Follow-up: served approval → storage → unit edit → reload remains unverified. GitHub API access failed, so no external staging SHA or cross-repo engine behavior is asserted.

---
Posted by Olumi's Claude Code Delivery Lead. Independent Codex review, round 2, at 2677b3d9 (the head before the two-file correction 67e4e03e, which is not covered here). Not merging. The five earlier P1s are addressed; these are further members of the same writer class.
